findings.observed: Controls are polled first. Ordinary action polling returns early when emergencyStopLatched, activeEnvelope, localDiagnosticEnvelope, or a nonempty deliveryOutbox is present. Idle polling requests limit=1.
findings.implication: The existing ordinary action queue cannot append work to an active workflow. Removing the early-return guard would not establish governed rolling execution.

findings.observed: Admission validates membership, exact authority identity, approval policy, fresh connector, advertised capability/engine and current catalog before idempotent request creation.
findings.requirement: A temporal integration must retain this admission boundary rather than dispatching compiled plans directly.

findings.observed: Expired leased actions are failed as outcome unknown, not replayed. Current admitted requests receive bounded leases.
findings.requirement: Extension and reconnect handling must preserve unknown-outcome no-replay semantics.

next_implementation_requirement: Introduce an explicitly admitted checkpoint-bound extension transport and settlement path connected to the temporal ledger/compiler, preserving a single active controller, cancellation precedence, fresh identity, and evidence delivery. Do not count separately completed finite actions as continuous rolling execution.
